verdict.rationale: Casium says it reviews your achievements, shows you how strong your case is, and lays out the pathway before filing. It mentions an assessment step (no assessment fees) and publishes an O-1A guide plus a blog on the principles behind strong O-1 petitions. But no evidence documents a structured, criterion-by-criterion evaluation of evidence against the O-1A USCIS criteria; the only explicit criteria-counting content concerns EB-1A. Missing for 10: a documented structured O-1A assessment methodology mapped to the USCIS criteria, a sample or description of the assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
